text: Every year, a few famous stores quietly start dying. Most people don't notice until the everything-must-go signs show up. Let's notice early.
I'm Sam. This is Last Receipt. Tonight, twelve big retailers closing stores across America in 2027, and the five warning signs they have in common.
After a lot of these bankruptcies, I keep seeing the same five warning signs. Watch for them in your own town.
Warning sign one: the shelves look full, but it's the same stuff it was six months ago. That means suppliers have stopped sending new things.
Warning sign three: the debt. When a company owes more each year than it earns, the clock is already running.
One sign means nothing. Three or more, and I'd spend that gift card this month.
Now, this next one surprised me. On paper, it looks fine. Look closer.
Here's the pattern. Look at how many of these names are carrying debt from a buyout. If you watched our Toys R Us episode, you know how that story ends.
If one of these is your store, here's what usually happens next. Gift cards stop working first, then returns, then the big discounts. In that order.
I'll keep this list updated all year. Subscribe, and you'll hear it here before the signs go up.
Which store on this list do you think goes first? Put your guess in the comments. We'll check back next December.
